title: redundant type annotation on dkim_signer in smtp main
description: smtp/main.rs line 199 declares 'let dkim_signer: Option<Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner<mail_auth::common::crypto::Ed25519Key, mail_auth::dkim::Done>>>' with the full generic written out explicitly. Type inference would resolve this from the if/else arms without the annotation. Removing the annotation reduces line length and noise. Idiomatic Rust omits redundant type annotations that inference can resolve.
